---
title: "check-non-standard-chars.yml"
---

Detect curly quotes, en/em dashes, and the multiplication sign in `.qmd`,
`.R`, and `.md` files, which can break Quarto and R rendering. The check fails
when it finds any, reporting each `file:line:col` so you can fix it.

## Inputs

| Input            | Type   | Default            | Description                                                     |
| ---------------- | ------ | ------------------ | --------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `python-version` | string | `'3.x'`            | Python version to set up.                                       |
| `extensions`     | string | `'.qmd, .R, .md'`  | Comma- or space-separated list of file extensions to check.     |
| `runs-on` | string | `'ubuntu-latest'` | Runner label for the job. Use a self-hosted label only for a private repository; never for a public one, whose pull requests can run arbitrary code on it ([#1167](https://github.com/Morrison-Lab/gha/issues/1167)). |

## Permissions

Only `contents: read` (the default), so no `permissions:` block is needed.

## Example

```yaml
name: Check non-standard characters
on:
  push: { branches: [main] }
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:
jobs:
  check:
    uses: Morrison-Lab/gha/.github/workflows/check-non-standard-chars.yml@v2
    # with:
    #   runs-on: private-runner  # self-hosted runner label (private repositories only)
```

See
[`examples/check-non-standard-chars.yml`](https://github.com/Morrison-Lab/gha/blob/main/examples/check-non-standard-chars.yml)
for the full caller stub.
